thread:
nora_acme: Hey team — invoice INV-9987 (charged yesterday) is missing our PO in the merchant portal. Our PO is ACME-PO-2024-0456 but the portal shows nothing in the 'Purchase ref' field. Payment succeeded, but accounting can't reconcile without the PO. Can someone look?

emma_support: Sorry about that, Nora. Can you confirm the invoice number and drop a screenshot if you have one? Also did you enter the PO during checkout or post-purchase?

nora_acme: Added the PO at checkout (field labelled 'purchase_ref'). Attaching screenshot in thread.

liam_billing: I pulled INV-9987 — payment status: settled. Ledger entry has purchase_ref = null. Looks like the payload that landed in our billing service didn't include the full PO.

sofia_finance: If payment is already settled we'll need to do a credit + reissue to get a corrected invoice with PO attached (audit-friendly). Before we start, does the PO affect tax/VAT calculation?

raj_engineering: Quick repro: I replayed the webhook from our gateway and the purchase_ref in the POST body is truncated. Original merchant payload: {"purchase_ref":"ACME-PO-2024-0456"} -> our ingest shows: {"purchase_ref":"ACME-PO-2024"}. Suspect string length cutoff in the webhook handler or DB schema.

raj_engineering: Snippet from our service logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z INFO incoming_webhook body={"invoice_id":"INV-9987","amount":12500,"purchase_ref":"ACME-PO-2024"}
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z DEBUG insert_into_invoices sql="INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_id, purchase_ref, ...) VALUES ('INV-9987','ACME-PO-2024',...)"
```

emma_support: @raj_engineering OK that explains missing PO in portal. What's the minimal remediation to preserve audit trail?

raj_engineering: Two parts: 1) short-term remediation: update the invoices table to set purchase_ref to the correct value for INV-9987 (manual patch) and re-run the notification job so the portal reflects it. 2) long-term: database migration to increase `purchase_ref` column to varchar(64) and fix webhook parsing. Patch is low-risk but we need approvals for DB write to a settled invoice (audit concern).

liam_billing: Finance needs a clear trail. Prefer not to mutate settled records directly. Sofia?

sofia_finance: We avoid editing settled invoices. Standard flow: issue a full credit for INV-9987, then create a new invoice INV-9987-R1 that includes purchase_ref and references the original. That keeps audit trail clean and matches GL. We also need to ensure VAT/tax lines match exactly.

emma_support: Nora — does a credit + reissue work for you? Will your AR system accept INV-9987-R1 as replacement?

nora_acme: That works, but we need the new invoice to show the exact PO string ACME-PO-2024-0456 or our ERP will still fail. Also need to confirm the credit posts today for close-of-month.

raj_engineering: For the reissue we can force the purchase_ref when creating INV-9987-R1 (we'll take the PO string from your message). I'll add a one-off field to the reissue job to include manual_purchase_ref so it doesn't rely on the faulty webhook.

billing-bot: Created internal ticket BILL-3421: "purchase_ref truncated by webhook -> credit + reissue required" (assigned to liam_billing, raj_engineering).

liam_billing: Action items: 1) finance (sofia) to approve credit + reissue GL codes and confirm VAT handling, 2) engineering (raj) to implement one-off reissue flow and a db migration plan, 3) support (emma) to confirm timeline with customer.

sofia_finance: Approved for credit + reissue once engineering confirms tax lines will match. GL: 4001 revenue reversal, 2100 accounts receivable. VAT: mirror original tax amounts — do not recompute.

raj_engineering: I'll run the one-off reissue this afternoon and attach purchase_ref exactly as provided. After reissue, I'll open a separate PR for DB migration (varchar(64)) and webhook validation.

emma_support: Nora, tentative timeline: reissue + credit today (ETA 6 hours) and final engineering fix next week. I'll DM updates. 

alex_customer: Quick question — will the credit note show as separate transaction in the portal? We need it for our audit pack.

liam_billing: Yes, credit note will appear as a separate document linked to the original invoice. The reissued invoice will reference the credit in its notes. We'll include a reconciliation CSV if you need it.

nora_acme: Thanks all — please include the exact PO string when reissuing: ACME-PO-2024-0456. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

emma_support: Noted. Will post confirmation once credit + reissue complete. :white_check_mark:
